finalText:
Build is now clean: exit code 0, "0 errors". The remaining 8 warnings are all deprecation noise from the dependency bump (Buffer(), sync loader hook, punycode, module.parent, etc.) — not failures.

The real problem was two bugs the bundler bump exposed in the link stage, both now fixed:

- `src/core/options.js:7` — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but this still read `options.retries` (undefined), which threw on `.toFixed()`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only handled explicit `false`/`true`, so `undefined` fell through to a thrown error. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled, same as `false`.

Build now completes and links successfully (retry budget resolves to 3, backoff correctly reports disabled).
